verdict.rationale: Semgrep's registry rules (p/python, security audit rules) explicitly detect injection-class vulnerabilities and XSS patterns, and this is directly confirmed by a hands-on probe showing a real scan flagging subprocess-shell-true injection with default rulesets, plus docs on writing custom security rules and cross-file analysis. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for security lint rules though notes false positives/negatives and performance issues as caveats.
